answer_1.quote: We introduce SSVP-SLT (Self-Supervised Video Pretraining for Sign Language Translation), an implementation of this framework consisting of two or optionally three stages: pretraining a continuous sign language encoder via masked autoencoding (MAE;  on anonymized video, then optionally bridging the modality gap via CLIP-style video-text pretraining , and finally training an SLT system via supervised finetuning using extracted features from the pretrained model.
answer_1.outputs: English text translations from ASL videos

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU via SacreBLEU .  We also report ROUGE-L  and BLEURT  from the BLEURT-20 checkpoint, which has been shown to correlate well with human judgments.
